config.description: Forward sampling-design calculation for frozen PF/KL budget-response predictions; saved before simulation, not an external preregistration
config.cost_error_structure: One seeded class-level Gaussian log error in auxiliary costs, centered across classes and shared before/after. Primary costs and sampling propensities remain known.
config.decision: Joint before/after multinomial deviance for each frozen candidate, calibrated with independent null draws and Monte Carlo rank p-values. Reject at candidate alpha. Outcomes: PF only accepted, KL only accepted, both accepted, both rejected.
config.interpretation: Truth models are imposed. Multinomial samples represent independent objects/opportunities conditional on cohort size; sampled resources do not obey a fixed budget. These power curves guide observation design and do not validate either natural objective.

calibrations.rejection_rule: Joint deviance strictly exceeds calibrated critical value; ties do not reject.
